leo.style: A youthful, pumped-up American guy, about 22, at the gym, like a funny anime short. 'Done! Every single rep!' is a loud, joyful shout, a little out of breath, like he just won. 'Chest. Back. Legs.' is smug and proud, slow, one word at a time. 'I forgot face day...' is a horrified, shaky whisper, as if he just remembered something terrible. 'Now it's every rep.' is proud and relieved, grinning

maya.style: A confident, playful American woman, about 23, his gym friend, teasing him in a dry, deadpan, amused voice, like a funny anime short. 'Every rep?' is doubtful, one eyebrow up. 'And face? You forgot your face reps, man.' is a teasing gotcha, slow and clear, with a short pause after 'And face?'. 'Sit. Five minutes.' is a firm coach. 'Fish Face.', 'Chin Lift.' and 'Brow Lift.' are short and clear, like a coach calling out moves. 'Don't skip face day.' is to the camera, playful and confident, like the end of an ad

lines.text: And face? You forgot your face reps, man.
